prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready on your desktop! Use keyboard shortcuts or click to interact."]
1: ["Create & Preview Your Custom Pet", "Upload a photo and see your companion take shape in real time.", "Upload Pet Photo"]
2: ["Select Your Ideal Companion Trait", "Pick a companion personality style that fits your daily desktop workflow.", "Focus Assistant Pet", "Playful Desktop Buddy"]
3: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Sign in with your primary account to automatically sync and retain your saved pets.", "Prevents Pet Data Loss", "Sign In with Existing Account"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop...", "If your pet does not appear on screen, check system tray permissions below.", "Check System Tray / Taskbar Icon", "Estimated setup time: 30s"]
5: ["Includes exclusive starter desktop toy for your pet!", "+ Free Starter Accessory"]
6: ["Choose a name your pet will recognize during desktop chat!", "Tip: You can rename your pet anytime in Settings."]
7: ["Sign In & Sync Your Pets", "Already adopted a pet? Sign in with the exact same account to prevent progress resets.", "Using a new account will create a separate fresh pet profile."]
8: ["Your Pet Has Arrived on Desktop!", "Hi there! Click me on your desktop to start interacting."]
9: ["Pick Your Companion", "Choose a pre-made pet or upload a photo to create a custom companion.", "Classic Desktop Cat", "Friendly Desktop Dog"]
